course_name_en: KMM3591 — Analysis Methods in Chemical Industry

learning_outcomes.text: Knowing the theories behind analysis methods
Will know the fundamentals of spectroscopic, thermal analysis, and chromatography methods
Ability to comprehend sample preparation techniques
Ability to evaluate analysis data, interpret and present graphics
Ability to research and report current application areas of analysis methods in different sectors

syllabus_topics: Spectroscopic Methods Used in Chemical Industry
Absorption Spectroscopy in Ultraviolet and Visible Region
